flavor_text.one_line: Horse-nomad raiders of the open steppe who explode into empires and scatter just as fast.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Orkhan ride the great grass-sea in clans bound by the sky-oath, despising walls and the soft folk behind them. A single uniting khan can fuse the clans into a horde that floods outward in a generation, taking tribute and torch alike; but the same fractiousness that births the horde shatters it when the khan dies. They leave few roads and fewer cities, only burial-mounds and the memory of thunder on the horizon.
